meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: 帮你完成 Git 操作:按行为拆出原子提交、做 rebase 或 squash、用 blame/bisect 查改动来源,并回答某处改动何时、由谁、为何发生。它先读仓库状态再动手。
howto.when: 当任务需要提交代码或调查 Git 历史时接管;普通代码编辑不触发。所有改写历史的操作只在你明确要求时才执行。

say.text: 把这些改动按行为拆成几个原子提交,并列出每个提交的哈希
say.note: 先看完整 diff,再按路径或 hunk 暂存

say.text: 找出引入这个字符串的提交,给出哈希和证据
say.note: 用 git log -S 检索并引用结果

say.text: 把最近三个提交压成一个,别动 main 分支
say.note: 重写前会确认当前分支与推送状态

howto.what_en: Handles your Git work: splitting changes into atomic commits, rebasing or squashing history, answering who/when/why a change landed via blame or bisect, and recovering via reflog. It reads repo state before acting.
howto.when_en: Triggers whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; ordinary code edits are skipped. History rewriting only runs when you explicitly ask.

say_en.text: Split these changes into atomic commits and list each commit hash.
say_en.note: Reads the full diff, stages by path or hunk

say_en.text: Find the commit that introduced this string, with the evidence.
say_en.note: Uses git log -S and cites results

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits without touching main.
say_en.note: Checks branch and push state first
